scale_1280.interpretation: Doubling roots from 640 to 1280 produced essentially flat cross-seed mean TV while average-policy fit degraded above the frozen gate on both seeds. Brute-force root scaling remains paused.

variance_decomposition_640.interpretation_limit: The within-memory comparisons were evaluated on the union of both memories and therefore include off-support extrapolation.

shared_deck_support_640.interpretation: Holding the hidden-card/future-board root stream common reduced across-memory mean TV only about 2.1%, so deck/chance-stream differences are not a plausible dominant explanation. The clean classifier remained conservative because one controlled policy fit finished slightly above the 0.12 gate. Off-support replica disagreement was about 2.43x own-support disagreement, making support fragmentation/generalization the next causal target.

support_overlap_640.purpose: Measure exact strategy-memory support intersection and LCFR-weighted target disagreement, then repeat after diagnostic global-suit canonicalization and poker card isomorphism that also removes private-card order and flop-card order.

rng_coupling_screen_256.purpose: Screen the known recovered coupling where bundle.batch_rng drives both traversal/action sampling and optimizer minibatch sampling. The split diagnostic gives traversal its own RNG while leaving production semantics untouched, measuring whether adaptive training RNG consumption materially changes later strategy-memory support or shared-target TV.

next_physical_step: Complete the running support-overlap and RNG-coupling diagnostics. If card isomorphism materially increases overlap with low shared-target disagreement, prioritize a versioned canonical-card neural representation and recertify R2-R7. If overlap stays low, use the RNG screen to decide whether to version and checkpoint separate traversal/training RNG streams before another acceptance-scale run. Frozen gates remain unchanged.
